semantic_fragments.content: Applied parts classification summary: No type CF applied part present. No defibrillation-proof applied parts. No connector symbols required for applied parts. No cardiac defibrillator discharge protection provisions. Equipment is assumed suitable for CONTINUOUS OPERATION per clause 7.2.11. No accessible fuse-holder present. No physiological effects hazard requiring safety signs. No high voltage terminal devices on exterior. No special cooling provision requirements. Equipment has limited mechanical stability (refer to 9.4). No special transport/storage handling instructions on packaging; permissible environmental conditions for transport and storage are marked on packaging. Equipment is PORTABLE (not MOBILE). Battery type and insertion mode marked in battery compartment.
